PR_Review-Benchmark-Dataset
	

A High-Signal Dataset for Evaluating AI Code Review & Test Generation Systems

	
		
		Overview
	

PR_Review-Benchmark-Dataset is a curated dataset of merged GitHub Pull Requests, code patches, and human review comments, designed for benchmarking:

AI Code Review Systems
Test Case Generation Models
Software Engineering LLMs

evaluation_method: human_eval, pass@k (for generated tests), F1/accuracy (for classification tasks)
general_score_metric: combination: pass@k for test generation and human_eval / F1 or accuracy for review/classification
reputation: A curated Hugging Face dataset aimed at AI code-review and test-generation research; gaining attention but not yet a broadly standardized benchmark.
